definitions.explanation: One particular aspect or facet of something that has multiple dimensions. Used when acknowledging that there is more to something than what is being discussed.

definitions.gloss: entire surface, as far as the eye can see
definitions.explanation: Describes a wide area completely covered or filled with something. Often used for natural scenes like fields of flowers or snow.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一面|いちめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない。
examples.english: That is only one aspect of the problem.
He also has a gentle side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切にする：26940_taisetsunisuru⟧{一面|いちめん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: He is a strict boss, but he also has a side that values his subordinates.

examples.japanese: {一面|いちめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雪景色|ゆきげしき}→雪景色：14666_yukigeshiki⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a snowscape as far as the eye could see.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{丘|おか}→丘：02183_oka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一面|いちめん}⟦{菜|な}の{花|はな}→菜の花：14042_nanohana⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{黄色|きいろ}く→黄色い：00959_kiiroi⟧⟦{染|そ}まる→染まる：04254_somaru⟧。
examples.english: In spring, this hill is dyed yellow with rapeseed flowers as far as the eye can see.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一面|いちめん}⟦{水浸|みずびた}し→水浸し：20704_mizubitashi⟧になっていた。
examples.english: After the typhoon, the entire garden was flooded.

notes:
{一面|いちめん} has two distinct uses. Sense 1 ("one aspect") focuses on a partial view of something multifaceted. Sense 2 ("entire surface") describes a wide expanse covered uniformly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
Sense 1:
- ⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧な{一面|いちめん} (unexpected side)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一面|いちめん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (also has a ~ side)
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一面|いちめん} (one aspect of the problem)

Sense 2:
- {一面|いちめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{銀世界|ぎんせかい}→銀世界：17523_ginsekai⟧ (a world of silver — snow everywhere)
- {一面|いちめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧ (spread across the entire surface)
- {一面|いちめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花畑|はなばたけ}→花畑：19767_hanabatake⟧ (a field of flowers as far as the eye can see)

USAGE:
- In newspapers, {一面|いちめん} also means "front page" (⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一面|いちめん})
- Sense 2 often appears as an adverb directly modifying a noun: {一面|いちめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧
